criteria.C1: <= 1.0 FP/host-hour at alert in every held-out environment; <= 0.1 at high where >= 20 h
criteria.C2: macro recall at alert: L1 - B2 (start-only, the v6/v7 ingredients) >= +0.15 with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0; L1 - B1 (rules, full replay) CI lower bound > -0.05
criteria.C3: macro partial AUC (FPR <= 1%) over environments with attacks >= 0.75; BOTSv1 >= 0.65
criteria.C4: benign-environment predictability macro AUC <= 0.70; no single group alone > 0.80; the availability pattern alone predicts the label with AUC <= 0.55
criteria.C5: start+lineage+children only: FP/host-hour <= B2's + 0.2 in every environment
criteria.C6: median time to detect (start -> first checkpoint over alert) <= 120 s
criteria.C7: bit-identical rebuild; golden parity <= 1e-9 including NaN vectors
criteria.C8: each held-out mutation family, and losing any one admitted family group at test time, costs <= 0.10 recall

protocol.selection_rule: candidates meeting C1's alert condition in every environment: highest macro recall wins; otherwise the lowest worst-environment FP/host-hour wins (and C1 fails)
protocol.decision_rule: L1 enters the engine (shadow mode, behind a flag) only if C1-C8 pass. Kill rule: if C1 or C2 fails, L1 is not shipped and L3 runs on rules plus rarity only

top_benign.command_line: wevtutil  epl "Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/FirewallVerbose" config\WindowsFirewallLogVerbose.evtx

selection.reason: no candidate meets C1 at alert; lowest worst-environment FP/host-hour

C7.note: bit-identical rebuild checked by rerunning this step into a second version
